steps.send: set -e -o pipefail; test "$(systemctl is-active gdm)" = active; test "$(awk '/^ [0-9]+ / {count++} END {print count}' /proc/asound/cards)" -eq 1; grep -q '^ 0 .*VirtIO SoundCard$' /proc/asound/cards; head -c 192000 /dev/zero | timeout 15 aplay -D hw:0,1 -t raw -c 2 -r 48000 -f S16_LE; timeout 15 arecord -D hw:0,1 -c 2 -r 48000 -f S16_LE -d 1 /tmp/dory-capture.wav; test "$(stat -c %s /tmp/dory-capture.wav)" -gt 192000; printf 'DORY_AUDIO_%s\n' IO_READY
